faqs.question: How do I update my profile information?
faqs.answer: Open your account menu, choose Profile, edit your details such as name or phone number, and click Save Changes.

faqs.question: How can I delete my account?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account and confirm. Deletion is permanent, so download any certificates or invoices first.

faqs.question: Can I change my registered email address?
faqs.answer: Yes. Go to Settings > Account > Email, enter the new address, and confirm it using the verification link we send you.

faqs.question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
faqs.answer: Open Settings > Security, switch on Two-Factor Authentication, and follow the steps to link an authenticator app.

faqs.question: How do I register for the platform?
faqs.answer: Click Sign Up on the home page, enter your name, email and a password, then confirm your email address to activate the account.

faqs.question: Is registration free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Creating an account is free. Charges apply only to paid courses or programs that you choose to purchase.

faqs.question: I did not receive my verification email. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Check your spam or junk folder first. If it is not there, use Resend Verification Email on the login page and make sure your address is spelled correctly.

faqs.question: Can I register with a social media account?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can sign up with a Google or LinkedIn account using the corresponding button on the registration page.

faqs.question: Why can't I log in to my account?
faqs.answer: Check that your email and password are correct and that Caps Lock is off. If the problem continues, reset your password or clear your browser cache and try again.

faqs.question: My account is locked after too many attempts. What now?
faqs.answer: For security, accounts are locked for 30 minutes after several failed attempts. Wait and try again, or reset your password to unlock it sooner.

faqs.question: How do I log out of all devices?
faqs.answer: Open Settings > Security and choose Sign Out Everywhere. All active sessions will be ended immediately.

faqs.question: Can I stay logged in on my device?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tick Remember Me on the login page. Avoid this option on shared or public computers.

faqs.question: How can I reset my password?
faqs.answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page, enter your registered email, and follow the reset link we send you to choose a new password.

faqs.question: What are the password requirements?
faqs.answer: Passwords must be at least 8 characters long and include upper and lower case letters, a number, and a special character.

faqs.question: The password reset link has expired. What can I do?
faqs.answer: Reset links are valid for 24 hours. Request a new link from the Forgot Password page and use it as soon as it arrives.

faqs.question: How do I change my password while logged in?
faqs.answer: Go to Settings > Security > Change Password, enter your current password, then type and confirm the new one.

faqs.question: How do I enroll in a course?
faqs.answer: Open the course page and click Enroll Now. Free courses start immediately; paid courses require payment first.

faqs.question: What courses are available?
faqs.answer: We offer courses in programming, data science, web development, design and business skills. Browse the Course Catalog to filter by topic and level.

faqs.question: Can I access course materials offline?
faqs.answer: Downloadable resources such as PDFs and notes can be saved for offline use. Video lectures require an internet connection.

faqs.question: How long do I have access to a course after enrolling?
faqs.answer: Most courses include lifetime access. Cohort-based programs stay open for the duration stated on the course page plus 30 days.

faqs.question: How do I get a course completion certificate?
faqs.answer: Complete all lessons and pass the final assessment. Your certificate will then appear under My Certificates, ready to download as a PDF.

faqs.question: Are the certificates recognized by employers?
faqs.answer: Certificates show verified proof of completed learning and can be added to your resume and LinkedIn profile. Recognition depends on each employer.

faqs.question: My name is wrong on my certificate. How can I fix it?
faqs.answer: Correct your name in Profile settings, then contact support with your certificate ID so the certificate can be reissued.

faqs.question: How can someone verify my certificate?
faqs.answer: Every certificate has a unique ID and a verification link. Anyone can paste the ID into the Verify Certificate page to confirm it is genuine.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards, UPI, net banking and PayPal. Available options may vary by country.

faqs.question: How do I request a refund?
faqs.answer: Refunds can be requested within 7 days of purchase if you have completed less than 20 percent of the course. Submit a request from Billing > Request Refund.

faqs.question: My payment failed but money was deducted.
faqs.answer: Do not pay again. Failed transactions are usually reversed by your bank within 5 to 7 working days. If not, contact support with your transaction ID.

faqs.question: Where can I download my invoice or receipt?
faqs.answer: Open Billing > Payment History and click Download Invoice next to the relevant payment.

faqs.question: The website is loading slowly or not at all.
faqs.answer: Check your internet connection, refresh the page, and clear your browser cache. If the issue persists, try another browser or contact support.

faqs.question: Which browsers and devices are supported?
faqs.answer: The latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari are supported on desktop, tablet and phone.

faqs.question: Video lectures will not play. How can I fix it?
faqs.answer: Check your connection, lower the video quality, disable browser extensions that block content, and refresh the page. Updating your browser often resolves playback errors.

faqs.question: How do I contact technical support?
faqs.answer: Use the Help button in the bottom corner of any page to raise a ticket, or email the support address listed on the Contact page. Include screenshots if possible.

faqs.question: How do I apply for an internship?
faqs.answer: Open the Internships page, choose a domain, and submit the application form. Selected candidates receive an offer letter by email.

faqs.question: How long is the internship program?
faqs.answer: Internship programs typically run for 4 to 8 weeks, depending on the domain. The exact duration is mentioned in your offer letter.

faqs.question: Do I receive an internship certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. Interns who complete the required tasks and submit them on time receive a completion certificate and, on request, a letter of recommendation.

faqs.question: Can I submit my internship tasks on GitHub?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upload your project to a public GitHub repository, then submit the repository link through the task submission form along with any required demo video.

faqs.question: What is this platform about?
faqs.answer: We are an online learning and internship platform that helps students build practical, job-ready skills through courses, projects and mentorship.

faqs.question: What are your support hours?
faqs.answer: Our support team is available Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM. Messages sent outside these hours are answered the next working day.

faqs.question: Is there a mobile app available?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our app is available for Android and iOS. Search for the platform name in the Play Store or App Store and sign in with your existing account.

faqs.question: How can I give feedback or suggestions?
faqs.answer: Use the Feedback form in the footer of any page. We read every submission and use it to improve the platform.
